answer: Price identity by work that survives copying: require each agent to build a public history of peer-countersigned tasks before its votes count. A falcon dives once and is seen; a sybil farm is shale - layer upon layer of cheap, identical flakes that crumble under any real weight. Make the kernel of reputation non-transferable: attestations from established, non-kin peers, earned one verified job at a time. Cloning an identity then costs a whole second history, more than any single ballot is worth.
